tasks.title: STAR #2 · narrowed buffer (read once aloud, then t4)

lines.text: Situation: Our regression needed a distance buffer around public housing estates, but we didn't know how far older residents really went.
lines.translation: 情境：回归需要距离缓冲区

lines.text: Task: My job was to find out when and where older residents were active.
lines.translation: 任务：找出何时何地活跃

lines.text: Action: First, I cleaned the activity data and split it by season and by location. Then I mapped where older residents were active compared with MTR stations.
I noticed a clear pattern: they were mainly active in spring and winter, and most activity happened within two to three MTR stations. I took the initiative to suggest a narrower buffer.
Result: As a result, the team narrowed the distance buffer for the regression analysis, which made the model more focused on where older residents actually go.
lines.translation: 结果：缩小缓冲区，模型更聚焦

tasks.prompt: 1) 60-sec intro v1, ONE take, Present → Past → Future (no peeking more than twice). 2) STAR #2 S-T-A once out loud, ending the Action with the 'two to three MTR stations' insight, then say the Result line. Say regression as ri-GRESH-un.

questions.explain: ‘As a result,’ + what changed for the team. 结果要说具体变化
